name: The Darkmoon Faire
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The Darkmoon Faire is coming!  Be sure to experience all the wonders and excitement of it when it comes to town!

If you act right now, you can redeem this voucher for free prize tickets!  Just hand your voucher to Gelvas Grimgate located inside the carnival.

Right now, the Faire is outside Goldshire, in the Elwynn Forest.  Don't miss out!  Go today!
narrative.objectives: Deliver the Free Ticket Voucher to Gelvas Grimgate, located inside the Darkmoon Faire carnival.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Welcome to the Darkmoon Faire! This voucher is good for FIVE, yes, FIVE prize tickets!

When you accumulate prize tickets, you'll want to speak to me about redeeming them for valuable prizes. The more tickets you get, the more prizes you can win. Huzzah!
narrative.requestItemsText: Yes friend, may I help you? Do you have a voucher that needs redeeming?
